stem: Why does the passage recommend budgeting for care as well as planting?
options: Young trees provide little shade at first and may not survive without attention.
Mature trees need to be replaced whenever nearby roads are repaired.
Newly planted trees require more water than reflective roofs do.
Trees can cool the air only after buildings have been redesigned.

verdicts.working: The passage says saplings initially provide little shade and may fail without watering or protection, so care must be budgeted.

working: The passage says saplings offer little shade and may fail to survive unless watered or protected in their first years.
solution: Saplings provide little shade initially and may not survive their first years without watering or protection. Therefore, budgets should include care as well as planting.
